source.name: Natural Earth 1:10m rivers + lake centerlines
source.processing: Selected main rivers by source river number, clipped to the terrain bounds, rounded coordinates to 5 decimals; separate source line parts retained.
source.limitations: Modern generalized river/lake centerlines at 1:10 million source scale. NOT ancient shorelines, NOT reconstructed Three Kingdoms river courses. Yellow River lower course in particular changed repeatedly after the Three Kingdoms.
